text.tspan: Full sena.listObservations is not part of startup. It remains for compatibility and export-style reads.
Read-only requests are coalesced before worker selection. Mutations always route to the writer and bump the read generation.
Startup summary reads use normalized hot tables. Checkpoint payloads live as compressed files referenced by SQLite metadata.

svg.text: load persisted compact SENA read cache
prepare generated dev-history workspace when empty or marked
invalidate SENA read cache when seeded
invoke sena.getObservationFingerprint for freshness when needed
route read by interactive or bulk lane
catalog, hot summary tables, latest run, fingerprint
wait for bridge, app context, workspace ready, route ready
relaunch with same data directory for warm startup
derive interactive, read-pool, and setup queue p95 metrics
